summary: Reviewed the inline r3 plan bytes only: this seat was instructed not to call a filesystem or shell tool, so the plan's src/gnd and tests line citations were not independently verified, and every concern below is an internal defect visible in the plan text itself. Several (p1) repairs hold as written: same-verdict scoped to accepted inputs with named exit-3 refusals, D6, the RP2-before-RP1 ordering in §3 and §9, the comparator extension with negative control RP2-C6, and the Ossie tests added to every phase lane. Three concerns are blocking: line :882 is cited both as the external-uniqueness refusal RP1 lifts and as an external-frequency refusal RP1 keeps; RP2-C4 and §5 promise a byte-identical textual report line while §10 requires the LQP program to gain textual not-checked lines; and RP2-C7 executes generated LQP code in the default lane, which §0 forbids and §8's venv split suggests the default environment cannot import. The remaining concerns are hardening gaps where a refusal or a divergence from GND is asserted without measurement, or where a §4 criterion names no lane that can discharge it.
